parts.instructions: Listen to the phone call and choose the best answer A, B, C or D (Questions L1–L5).
parts.context: Lucy, who works in the accounts department, phones Omar at the IT helpdesk.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Hi, it's Lucy from Accounts. I saved a spreadsheet this morning, but now I can't find it anywhere.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: OK, don't worry. Do you remember the filename?

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Right. First, could you just click on the folder icon at the bottom of the screen? That opens File Explorer.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: Now click on This PC in the left-hand pane. Then type June Sales in the search box in the top right-hand corner and press Enter.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: It's searching... Yes! There it is. It's in a folder called Old Reports.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: That's why you couldn't find it. You probably saved it there by mistake. Now, can you right-click on the file and select Properties? I'd like to check the size.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: It says two point four megabytes.

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: That's fine. Finally, just drag the file into your Accounts folder so that you can find it easily next time.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: OK. Do I need to delete it from Old Reports after that?

script.speaker: Omar
script.text: No, dragging moves the file, so there won't be a second copy.

options.text: She can't find a spreadsheet she saved.
Her computer won't start this morning.

parts.instructions: Listen to the message and answer the questions. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS for each answer (Questions L6–L10).
parts.context: Megan, an IT manager, tells Jack, an IT assistant, about the new laptops for the sales team.

script.speaker: Megan
script.text: Hi Jack, it's Megan. Before the meeting, let me tell you about the new laptops for the sales team. Each one has a two point six gigahertz quad-core processor, sixteen gigabytes of memory and a one terabyte solid state drive.

script.speaker: Megan
script.text: There's no optical drive, so if anyone needs to use a DVD, they'll need an external drive. The screen is fourteen inches, and the laptops are very light, so they're easy to carry. They have three USB ports and a headphone socket, but there's no Ethernet connector, so staff will have to use the wi-fi in the office. The battery lasts about ten hours. Each laptop also comes with a bag and a wireless mouse, so please check that those are in the boxes too.

script.speaker: Megan
script.text: Could you check the delivery when it arrives on Thursday? The supplier is sending twenty laptops, and I'd like you to make sure they're all there. If anything is missing, please phone the supplier straight away and let me know before the end of the day. Thanks!

questions.stem: How much memory does each laptop have?
questions.explanation: Megan nói "sixteen gigabytes of memory". Một terabyte là dung lượng ổ SSD, không phải bộ nhớ.

questions.stem: What will staff need if they want to use a DVD?
questions.explanation: Máy không có ổ quang nên "they'll need an external drive".

questions.stem: How will staff connect to the network in the office?
questions.explanation: Máy không có cổng Ethernet nên "staff will have to use the wi-fi in the office".

questions.stem: How long does the battery last?
questions.explanation: "The battery lasts about ten hours."

questions.stem: On which day will the delivery arrive?
questions.explanation: "Could you check the delivery when it arrives on Thursday?"

matching.instructions: Match the terms (1–5) with the correct definitions (A–F). There is one extra definition that you do not need (Questions 1–5).

definitions.text: A board where all the circuits of a computer are placed.
A pair of special glasses that let you see an environment produced by a computer that looks and seems real.
To divide the storage area of a hard disk into two or more parts.
A unique set of numbers and letters that you type in to prove that you have a licence to use a program.
A video camera that shows what it is filming on a website or on another person's computer.
The coloured bar at the top of a window that shows the name of the program.

items.explanation: Partition (phân vùng) là chia vùng lưu trữ của ổ cứng thành hai hay nhiều phần.
Title bar (thanh tiêu đề) là thanh màu trên cùng của cửa sổ, hiện tên chương trình.
Webcam là máy quay truyền hình ảnh đang quay lên trang web hoặc sang máy tính của người khác.
Product key (khoá sản phẩm) là dãy chữ và số duy nhất, nhập vào để chứng minh bạn có bản quyền dùng chương trình.
Motherboard (bo mạch chủ) là bảng mạch chứa toàn bộ mạch điện của máy tính. Định nghĩa B là của virtual reality goggles (kính thực tế ảo), không có trong danh sách thuật ngữ.

grammar.stem: 1,000 gigabytes is the same as one ______.
grammar.explanation: Tiền tố tera- lớn gấp 1.000 lần giga-: 1.000 GB = 1 TB. Mega- và kilo- nhỏ hơn giga-.

grammar.stem: The cable is 2.75 metres long. How do we say '2.75'?
grammar.explanation: Số thập phân đọc "point" ở dấu chấm và đọc từng chữ số sau dấu chấm: two point seven five, không đọc "seventy-five".

grammar.stem: ______, click the Start button. Then select 'Control Panel'.
grammar.explanation: Bước đầu tiên dùng từ nối trình tự "First"; câu sau là "Then …". "Finally/Last" chỉ bước cuối; "After" không đứng một mình như vậy.

grammar.stem: Plug the projector cable ______ the video socket on the laptop.
grammar.explanation: Câu có hai tân ngữ: plug + tân ngữ + into + tân ngữ (cắm cáp vào ổ cắm).

grammar.stem: When you have finished, unplug the headphones ______ the computer.
grammar.explanation: unplug + tân ngữ + from + tân ngữ (rút tai nghe ra khỏi máy tính).

grammar.stem: I use an external hard drive ______ back up my photos.
grammar.explanation: Chỉ mục đích với động từ nguyên mẫu dùng "to + V". "for" đi với danh từ, "so that" và "because" đi với mệnh đề.

grammar.stem: I bought a new graphics card ______ my computer was too slow for video editing.
grammar.explanation: Vế sau nêu lý do (máy quá chậm), là một mệnh đề nên dùng "because". "so that" chỉ mục đích, không hợp nghĩa.

vocabulary.stem: Drag the ______ down to see the bottom of the page.
vocabulary.explanation: Scroll bar (thanh cuộn) nằm ở cạnh màn hình, kéo lên xuống để xem phần trên hoặc dưới trang.

vocabulary.stem: ______ on the folder icon to open it.
vocabulary.explanation: Double click (nhấp đúp) vào biểu tượng để mở thư mục.

vocabulary.stem: Click the ______ button to make the window very small but keep the program open.
vocabulary.explanation: Nút Minimise thu nhỏ cửa sổ nhưng chương trình vẫn mở. Maximise phóng to hết cỡ; Close đóng chương trình; Restart khởi động lại.

vocabulary.stem: We use a ______ to show slides on a large screen in the meeting room.
vocabulary.explanation: Projector (máy chiếu) chiếu hình ảnh lên màn hình hoặc bề mặt phẳng.

vocabulary.stem: Please wear ______ if you listen to music in the office, so that you don't disturb other people.
vocabulary.explanation: Headphones (tai nghe) đeo trên tai để nghe mà người khác không nghe thấy. Speakers phát ra loa ngoài.

vocabulary.stem: ______ the window so that it fills only half of the screen.
vocabulary.explanation: Resize (đổi kích thước) là thay đổi kích cỡ của cửa sổ.

vocabulary.stem: ______ software lets users see the program code and change it themselves.
vocabulary.explanation: Open source (mã nguồn mở) là phần mềm cung cấp kèm mã nguồn để người dùng xem và tự sửa. Proprietary là phần mềm độc quyền, người dùng không xem hay sửa được mã nguồn.

vocabulary.stem: An ______ hard drive is not inside the computer case; it connects with a USB cable.
vocabulary.explanation: External (gắn ngoài) là thiết bị không nằm trong vỏ máy mà nối bằng cáp hoặc không dây.

passageMcq.instructions: Read the passage and choose the best answer A, B, C or D (Questions 21–25).

passage.title: New Computers for Greenway Architects
paragraphs: Greenway Architects is replacing the computers in its office this year. The old machines are seven years old, and staff often complain that they are slow. The IT manager, Sofia Grant, has written two different specifications, because the administration team and the design team do very different work.

The administration staff mainly use email, word processing and spreadsheets, so they do not need very powerful machines. Sofia thinks that the new computers will be fast enough for them for the next five years. Sofia has chosen desktop computers with a 2.8 GHz dual-core processor, 8 GB of memory and a 500 GB hard disk drive. The administration office will also move to open source office software, which will reduce the company's licence costs.

The designers are different. They work with large 3-D models and high-resolution images, so they need much faster computers. Their new machines will have a 3.6 GHz eight-core processor, 32 GB of memory and a 2 TB solid state drive for speed. Each designer will also get a large 32-inch monitor so that they can see small details in their drawings. They will keep their proprietary design software, because the open source alternatives are not as good for graphics.

The new computers will arrive in March. Sofia plans to install them at the weekend so that staff do not lose any working time. Before then, she will copy every user's files to the server, and on Monday morning she will visit each desk to check that everything works.

questions.stem: Why has Sofia written two different specifications?

options.text: The two teams do very different work.
The supplier has two price lists.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: "because the administration team and the design team do very different work". Bài nói công ty thay máy ở "its office", không nói có hai văn phòng.

questions.stem: What will the administration computers have?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: máy của bộ phận hành chính có "8 GB of memory". Các thông số A, B, D là của máy cho nhà thiết kế.

questions.stem: Why will each designer get a large monitor?

options.text: To use two computers at once
To see small details in drawings

questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: "a large 32-inch monitor so that they can see small details in their drawings".

questions.stem: Why will the designers keep their proprietary software?

options.text: The open source options are worse for graphics.
The new computers cannot run other software.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: "because the open source alternatives are not as good for graphics".

questions.stem: Why will Sofia install the new computers at the weekend?

options.text: So that staff do not lose working time
Because the computers arrive on Saturday
To test the design software first
Because the office is closed in March

questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: "install them at the weekend so that staff do not lose any working time".

passageTrueFalse.instructions: Read the passage and write T (True) or F (False) (Questions 26–30).

passage.title: Reinstalling the Operating System
paragraphs: Hi Leo, here are the steps for reinstalling the operating system on your laptop. First, back up all your files to an external drive, because the installation will delete everything on the laptop. Then insert the installation USB stick and restart the laptop. While it is starting, press the F2 key to open the BIOS. In the BIOS, choose the USB stick as the first boot drive, then save the change and reboot again.

This time, the laptop will start from the USB stick, and the installation will begin. Near the start, you have to agree to the licence terms. During the process, the laptop will restart by itself several times, so please don't switch it off. The whole process usually takes about forty minutes. You can do other work while you wait, but keep the laptop connected to a power socket.

At the end, the operating system will ask you for the time, the date and your network details. After that, you can create your user account and copy your files back from the external drive. Best wishes, Hannah

questions.statement: The installation will delete everything on Leo's laptop.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: "the installation will delete everything on the laptop".

questions.statement: Leo should press the F2 key to open the BIOS.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: "press the F2 key to open the BIOS".

questions.statement: Leo should switch off the laptop when it restarts during the process.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: máy sẽ tự khởi động lại nhiều lần "so please don't switch it off".

questions.statement: The whole process usually takes about four hours.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: quá trình thường mất "about forty minutes" (khoảng 40 phút).

questions.statement: Leo creates his user account at the start of the installation.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: tài khoản người dùng được tạo ở cuối ("At the end … After that, you can create your user account").

email.modelAnswer:
From: Tran Bao Ngoc
To: Daniel
Date: 25th November
Subject: Setting up your second monitor

Hi Daniel,

It should be quite easy to set up your second monitor.
First, connect the monitor cable to the video socket.
Then, plug the power cable into a socket and switch the monitor on.
Next, right-click on the desktop and select 'Display settings'.
After that, choose 'Extend these displays' and click 'Apply' to use both screens.
Finally, just drag a window onto the second screen to test it.
Could you call the helpdesk if there is a problem?
Don't forget to tidy the cables when you've finished.

Best wishes,
Tran Bao Ngoc
Support Technician
Help Desk Department

parts.instructions: Answer the three questions. Speak for 30–45 seconds for each question.
questions: Describe the computer or phone that you use most. What are its specifications? Say the numbers clearly, for example two point four gigahertz or five hundred and twelve gigabytes.
How do you connect your phone or laptop to other devices, for example headphones, a speaker or a TV? Use sentences with two objects (plug … into …, connect … to …).
Do you prefer open source or proprietary software? Give your reasons using because, for, to or so that.

parts.instructions: Give instructions for using a computer. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: A new colleague does not know how to organise files on a computer. Explain how to create a new folder on the desktop, give it a name and move a file into it. Use imperatives, sequence words (first, then, next, after that, finally) and at least one softener (could you…?, just).
cues: right-click on an empty part of the desktop
type a name for the folder / press Enter
drag a file onto the folder icon
double click on the folder to check the file is there
requiredGrammar: Sequencers: first, then, next, after that, finally
parts.sampleAnswer: OK, it's quite easy to make a new folder. First, just right-click on an empty part of the desktop. A menu will appear. Then select 'New', and after that choose 'Folder'. A new folder icon will appear on the desktop. Next, type a name for the folder, for example 'Project reports', and press Enter. Now could you find the file that you want to move? Click on it, hold the mouse button down and drag it onto the folder icon. Then let go of the button. Finally, double click on the folder to open it and check that the file is inside. If you want to move more files, just do the same again.

parts.instructions: Deal with the situation. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: You are a technician at a language school. Tomorrow a teacher is giving a hybrid lesson from a classroom computer: some students will be in the classroom, and other students will join online from home. Explain what equipment the teacher needs, how to connect each item and why each one is needed. Use sentences with two objects (plug … into …, connect … to …, unplug … from …) and reason or purpose (to…, so that…, because…, for…).
cues: a headset with a microphone: plug it into a USB port / so that the online students can hear the teacher clearly
a projector: connect it to the video socket / to show the online students on the wall for the class in the room
speakers: plug them into the audio socket / so that the students in the room can hear the online students
after the lesson: unplug everything from the computer / lock the cupboard
requiredGrammar: Sentences with two objects: plug the headset into the USB port; connect the projector to the computer; unplug the speakers from the computer
Reason and purpose: to + verb; so that + clause; because + clause; for + noun
parts.sampleAnswer: For your hybrid lesson tomorrow, you'll need three pieces of equipment. First, you need a headset with a microphone. Plug the headset into one of the USB ports on the front of the computer, so that the students at home can hear you clearly. Second, you need the projector. Connect the projector to the video socket on the back of the computer to show the online students on the wall. Then the students in the classroom can see them. Third, use the speakers, because the students in the room also need to hear the online students when they speak. Just plug the speakers into the audio socket. After the lesson, please unplug everything from the computer and put it in the cupboard for safety. Then lock the cupboard and bring the key to the IT office.
